nphi.title: ARILAC – Advancing Regional Integrated Laboratory Capacity for AMR Control
nphi.actor: Africa CDC with African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
nphi.with: European Union (Team Europe Initiative on Sustainable Health Security); Ethiopian Public Health Institute and national AMR reference laboratories
nphi.summary: Four-year EU-supported One Health laboratory initiative launched May 2026 to strengthen integrated laboratory-based AMR surveillance and lab capacity in eight AU member states.

nphi.title: ANTENNA – Training hubs for statisticians and epidemiologists in Eastern, Central and Western Africa
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Pública (INASA) Guinea-Bissau; Senegal Ministry of Health and Social Action; Hôpital Général de Douala; CRID Cameroon; University of Buea; RARS; UCAD; Joint Clinical Research Centre; Instituto Piaget; Universidade Nova de Lisboa; LSHTM; Universidade de Cabo Verde
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project creating cross-regional training hubs for epidemiology and biostatistics fellows in Cameroon, Senegal and Guinea-Bissau, with Guinea-Bissau's national public health institute INASA as a beneficiary.

nphi.title: AFRITRAC – African Training Network for Biostatistics, Epidemiology and Infectious Disease Modelling
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burundi; Africa CDC (partner); Université de Yaoundé I; USTTB Bamako; University of St Andrews; Makerere University; APHRC; University of Cape Coast; CERMEL; Mbarara University; Université Catholique de Bukavu
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network training 35 early-career professionals through a harmonised master's programme and regional hub, with Tanzania's NIMR, Burundi's INSP and Africa CDC involved.

nphi.title: Africa CDC Central Africa Regional Collaborating Centre (Libreville)
nphi.with: Government of Gabon (host of Central Africa RCC, Libreville)
nphi.summary: Africa CDC operationalised its Central Africa RCC in Libreville in 2017, with Gabon providing offices, an emergency operations centre and biosafety labs to serve nine Central African states.

nphi.title: CDC Cameroon country office
nphi.with: Ministry of Public Health; National Public Health Laboratory; Cameroon FETP (CAFETP); Centre for Research in Infectious Diseases (CRID); Public Health Emergency Operations Center
nphi.summary: CDC has supported Cameroon since 1998 (office 2004), working with the Ministry of Public Health on surveillance, the national public health lab, emergency management (PHEOC), the CAFETP, HIV/TB, malaria and immunization.

nphi.title: Institution-Based Network on China–Africa Cooperation for Schistosomiasis Elimination
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: University of Yaoundé; Theodor Bilharz Research Institute (Egypt); African schistosomiasis programmes
nphi.summary: Network of Chinese and African institutions working on schistosomiasis elimination, hosted by NIPD. Its 7th annual meeting was held in Haikou in 2022.

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg
nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: TB-COVID – COVID-19 impact on TB programmes in West and Central Africa
nphi.with: WHO Global TB Programme; WHO/TDR; WARN-TB/CARN-TB; HISP, University of Oslo (Norway)
nphi.summary: Built NTP capacity to monitor and mitigate COVID-19 disruption to TB services via a framework, DHIS2 package and preparedness plans.

nphi.title: ICMR/AU-STRC Health Practitioners and Researchers Capacity Building Scheme
nphi.with: African Union Scientific, Technical and Research Commission (AU-STRC); ICMR-National Institute of Cancer Prevention and Research (NICPR), Noida
nphi.summary: Under the ICMR–African Union MoU, ICMR set up a capacity-building scheme for African health researchers. Its first course, on molecular biology techniques for cancer research, trained 11 researchers from nine African countries at…

nphi.title: ALERRT – African coaLition for Epidemic Research, Response and Training
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB); Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire; Institut Pasteur de Bangui; Institut Pasteur de Madagascar; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; Bernhard-Nocht-Institut; ITM Antwerp; KNUST; ALIMA
nphi.summary: EDCTP2-funded network building clinical research capacity to respond rapidly to epidemics in sub-Saharan Africa. Partners include national biomedical/public health institutes (INRB, UNHRO) and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: Annual West and Central Africa surveillance and health information systems workshop (Dakar, 2020)
nphi.with: US CDC (Atlanta and Senegal offices); WHO; HISP West and Central Africa
nphi.summary: Fourth annual IANPHI–US CDC technical workshop (Dakar, March 2020) where seven Francophone African countries shared experience on surveillance data use, DHIS2 roll-out, One Health zoonoses assessment and community event-based surveillance.

nphi.title: DQA and DQA PLUS – Quality assurance training for African drug quality control labs
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: WHO Regulation and Safety (Switzerland); InphA (Germany); national regulatory authorities and drug quality control labs of partner countries
nphi.summary: Trained national drug QC lab staff in ISO 17025 quality management to detect substandard anti-infectives.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 048 – Improved regional management of outbreaks in the African Atlantic Façade
nphi.with: Expertise France; Institut Pasteur; Fondation Mérieux; IRD; French Ministry of Health; CNCMFE NRBC-E; FIIAPP
nphi.summary: EU-funded project in which Santé publique France, Institut Pasteur and other French and Spanish bodies built outbreak preparedness and rapid-response teams in 11 West and Central African countries after the Ebola epidemic.

nphi.title: IANPHI Ebola preparedness support to West and Central African countries
nphi.summary: In 2014–2015, IANPHI and its members gave funds and technical help to Guinea, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Guinea-Bissau. The help covered case-management training, prevention messages, protective equipment, specimen handling, screening at…
